when: a value that used to be single (one per model, engine or instance) becomes a set of per-unit values (per group, per layer, per worker), and some APIs, endpoints or consumers that exposed or used the old single value are left on the single-value contract
expect: Find every API, endpoint and consumer of the old single value, including status, reporting, logging and metrics paths, and change each one to carry or report the per-unit values. Do not keep the old single-value contract through a shim such as picking one representative entry or answering 'unsupported' when the units differ.
why: A consumer still on the single-value contract silently misreports or mishandles every unit but the chosen one once the units differ, and leaves the contract inconsistent across consumers.
examples: The KV cache format became per kernel group, but the API still returned group_formats[0] instead of being updated to expose every group's format.
report_status still reported a single KV cache format after the split and had to report one for each kernel group.
concern: When a single value becomes per-group, update every API and consumer to carry per-group values
